title: Cohomology of a module on a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and let $\mathcal F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Choose an injective resolution $\mathcal F[0]\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ in the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [lem-sc-ringed-space-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]. Define $H^p(X,\mathcal F)$, for $p\ge0$, to be the $p$-th cohomology group of the cochain complex $\Gamma(X,\mathcal I^\bullet)$; this is independent of the chosen resolution and gives the right derived functors of global sections.
